content: API Function Header File Description CanIf_TTApplWatchdogError TtcanIf.h Reports an application watchdog error. CanIf_TTGap TtcanIf.h Reports the occurrence of a gap. CanIf_TTMasterStateChange TtcanIf.h Reports change of the master state between potential and current master. CanIf_TTSevereError TtcanIf.h Reports one of the following errors: • failed to serve appl. watchdog • config error • watch trigger reached CanIf_TTStartOfCycle TtcanIf.h Reports the start of a basic cycle. CanIf_TTTimeDisc TtcanIf.h Reports a time discontinuity. CanIf_TTTimingError TtcanIf.h Reports one of the following errors: • Change of error level • Tx overflow / underflow • Synchronization failed • Init watch trigger
